stateNote: Place the roasting pan in the preheated oven and roast the lamb for approximately 25 minutes per pound (or 55 minutes per kilogram) for medium-rare doneness. Use a meat thermometer to check the internal temperature of the lamb. It should read around 60°C (140°F) for medium-rare. While the lamb is roasting, baste it occasionally with the pan juices to keep it moist and flavorful.
